messages:
rachael-design: Quick heads-up: I'm proposing the leftbar be re-grouped into task buckets (Deploy, Models, Billing, Config) instead of org folders. Need a couple of engineery confirmations: deep links, breadcrumb behavior when leftbar is collapsed, and copy for the nav label.

tom-fe: Task buckets seem cleaner. Two implementation rules: 1) collapsing the leftbar must be purely visual (no history change), 2) panels should be driven by a query param (panel=overview/logs) so navigation is deterministic.

ali-a11y: Accessibility items: when a deep URL opens a panel, keyboard focus should move to the panel heading and an aria-live message should say "Opened: <Panel>". If there's an anchor inside the panel, we should scroll to it first then announce. Also ensure skiplinks are ordered: Main content, Projects, Search.

nora-prod: Microcopy: leftbar label should read "Projects". When someone uses "Copy link" from a panel, toast text should be like: "Link copied — opens Logs at line 73". Important: old public links need to continue working; we can add a tiny redirect map server-side.

tom-fe: Router sketch: /app/:org/projects/:id?panel=logs&anchor=line-73. On route change use history.pushState. For UI-only toggles (collapse/compact) don't touch history. Will also ensure analytics doesn't use replaceState.

rachael-design: Breadcrumbs: show task path e.g. Projects > Acme > Logs with chevrons (>) and no trailing slash. When leftbar is compact, render a slim breadcrumb above the content.

ali-a11y: Also: tooltips in compact mode must have aria-labels and keyboard access to expand nav. Collapsing must not reorder tab stops.

tom-fe: Noted. I'll add an e2e that loads a legacy /workspace/* path, asserts redirect, navigates to panel+anchor, waits for element, then checks aria-live message.

build-bot: ci: nav-refactor branch build #1284 passed :white_check_mark:

rachael-design: Thanks! If no objections I'll lock on task buckets + panel query param routing and update the prototype: https://figma.com/file/redwood/nav-ux-proto :sparkles:
